page.overview:
Who is Booker?

Booker was a mercenary alongside Zora, who he was good friends with.

Zora and Booker were on a basic drill in Yemen. They were in a car when a car bomb went off. Booker slowly died. This memory has haunted Zora since then.

The memory of Booker's death continued to haunt Zora. Duncan and her had a conversation about him on their way to Ile Saint-Hubert.
